fred pierson.name: Fred Pierson
fred pierson.origin: Fred Pierson was a New York City police officer who spent two years undercover gathering evidence against six crime families. He hired Deadpool for a high-paying job to eliminate the mob bosses, using Ananastasia as the source of information. Pierson never revealed that the bosses were Ananastasia’s former lovers and that the two were manipulating Deadpool for insurance money. After most of the bosses were killed, Pierson and Ananastasia betrayed Deadpool and buried him alive. When Pierson later tried to cheat Ananastasia out of the money, she freed Deadpool and then killed Pierson.

fred raymond.name: Fred Raymond
fred raymond.species: Human, possibly with Inhuman lineage (see notes)Category:Human/Inhuman Hybrids
fred raymond.origin: Fred Raymond was an expert in asbestos who began working with Dr. Phineas Horton before the creation of the Human Torch. While working with Dr. Horton, Fred began to feel the effects of longtime exposure to asbestoes and left Dr. Horton's employ due to failing health. At some point after this he married, Nora and they had a child together Thomas whom they nicknamed "Toro" in memory of their Mexican honeymoon. Whilst raising Toro, the family were attacked by the Asbestos Lady who wanted to kidnap Fred to use his knowledge of asbestos for criminal purposes. The family was saved by the intervention of the Human Torch, but the Asbestos Lady escaped. Learning Nora, who was sick from her radium experiments, had a few more weeks to live, Fred took his family on vacation but while they were travelling by train, the Asbestos Lady caused the train to crash, killing both Fred and Nora.

fields.notes: Toro had no origin for decades, apart from being the survivor of a train wreck, undamaged by fire, while his parents died, as depicted in his first appearance in (September, 1940). Roger Stern (who was undoubtful that others had their own explanations) wanted Toro and his parents to be "secret emissaries of the Inhuman, sent out into the work on a inspection trip". Eventually becoming a Marvel writer, he couldn't go that way, as Roy Thomas made Toro a mutant in (November, 1977). Considering it a "reasonable enough origin", that eliminated for Stern the need of implementing his idea. His origin was later retconned in (July 23, 2014), in the wake of the Infinity and Inhumanity events, as being a human with a recessive Inhuman gene who had reacted to the Horton Cells when he came in contact with the Human Torch, but underwent further changes activated by a Terrigen Bomb. It remains whether of his parents (if not both) were carrying Inhuman lineage in their genetics.

Just as they were arguing about how to handle things, Bullseye attacked them through their window, demanding $100,000 and agreed to give the couple 24 hours to raise the money if they didn't call the police. freddie prinze jr.name: Freddie Prinze Jr.
freddie prinze jr.origin: Freddie Prinze Jr. was a Hollywood actor. Betty Ross, Director of Communications and Public Relations Officer of the super-team Ultimates, had dinner with Prinze in an attempt to have him portray Iron Man in a trilogy of movies about Ultimates. While Ross and Prinze were having dinner together, she was phoned by her ex-boyfriend, Dr. Bruce Banner, to tell her that he was to turn into the Hulk. In a fit of jealousy, the Hulk attacked the restaurant and caused several victims and collateral damage. Prinze and Ross escaped the restaurant, then they were evacuated by airborne military to be used as bait for Hulk and lead him away from more populated areas and defeat him without further damage. Hulk insistently begged Ross to not leave Banner for Prinze, then was defeated by the Wasp. After the disaster, Ross admitted that she was flirting with Prinze, and that may have contributed to Hulk's rampage. Prinze later spent a night with Betty Ross.
abilities: Prinze was a successful Hollywood actor.

freddy few.name: Freddy Few
freddy few.origin: Wily Trenchcoat was a famous detective who wanted to take some time off from any mystery that required his detective skills. For this purpose he chose a place among the tropical islands and disguised himself by putting a wig on his head to hide his baldness instead of his usual and unmistakable cap and starting to smoke cigars instead of his proverbial pipe. During a breakfast he was recognized by Freddy Few of the police of the islands who told him that there was a mystery that only he could solve, but Wily was more than determined not to want to get involved in any mystery and to continue with his vacation. He then went by boat to a small island to rest peacefully but once he fell asleep he was awakened by the shouts of two criminals who were arguing and immediately after attacked by a pack of savages who almost hit him from afar making his wig fly off. Having escaped from the islet, he went to Freddy Few telling him what had happened and to go there to arrest the two criminals, but Few told him that the island was uninhabited. Wily insisted, so Few replied that if he was right and there was no one on the island, then Wily would help him solve the mystery. Going together to the islet, they found no savages and even less criminals, so Few told Wily that that was Parrot Island and that a month before there had been a film crew shooting a movie and the parrots on the island repeated the phrases heard during the recording while the wig had not been hit by the savages but by a parrot that had taken it to make a nest.

freddy sloan.name: Freddy Sloan
freddy sloan.origin: Freddy Sloan was a fugitive attempting to evade police capture after committing unspecified crimes. Believing himself cornered, Sloan sought refuge inside a wax museum, assuming law enforcement would not think to search for him there. Once inside the darkened building, Sloan began hearing a disembodied voice repeatedly warning, “You’re not safe.” Unable to locate the source and increasingly unnerved by the silent wax figures surrounding him, Sloan’s fear escalated into panic. The oppressive atmosphere of the museum, combined with the relentless repetition of the message, caused his psychological state to deteriorate rapidly. Overcome by terror, Sloan ultimately chose to flee the museum and surrender to the police waiting outside rather than remain inside with the unseen presence he believed was pursuing him. After Sloan’s arrest, the museum’s caretaker discovered that a gramophone had been left running, its needle stuck in a groove that endlessly repeated the same lyric Sloan had heard. While initially dismissing the incident as accidental, the caretaker contacted his daughter Kathy to warn her not to leave the machine playing unattended. Kathy insisted she had not turned it on, prompting both to uneasily observe the surrounding wax statues, leaving open the possibility that Sloan’s fear had not been entirely unfounded.

freddy sykes.name: Freddy Sykes
freddy sykes.origin: Freddy Sykes was a convict who spent most of his time on the inside reading fairy tales. He was particularly fond of the tale of Aladdin and his genie. When he was released, Sykes became obsessed with the idea of genies and began researching more about them. He came across an old report which claimed that a gypsy man had discarded a bottle supposedly containing a genie in Blackwood Marsh in the Southern United States. Sykes immediately took a freight train down south and began scouring the marsh, searching for his prize. After weeks of painstaking searching, Sykes found what he was looking for and there really was a Genie inside the bottle who was forced to obey Sykes' every wish. Sykes wasted little time in having the Genie build him a castle of solid gold right in the middle of the swamp. Next he had the Genie create a winged steed for him and then forced him to drain the Atlantic Ocean, despite what that would do to all of the sea life. Sykes then decided that he was going to become ruler of the world and figured that the best way to start would be to put a scare into everyone, so he had the Genie blot out the sun for a time. Sykes then had the notion that rather than be dependent on the power of someone else, he should become the Genie himself and have all of the power. So he wished to trade places with the Genie. Once they switched, however, Sykes realized with horror that he was forced to obey the commands of the former Genie, who now possessed the bottle. The Genie had Sykes undo all of the wishes that he had done and then forced him back into the bottle and discarded the bottle back into the swamp with Sykes inside. Months later, a man passed by the bottle in the swamp. He opened it, but saw nothing inside and so discarded it. This left Sykes to leave the bottle with no master. Vowing revenge on everyone, Sykes quickly took over the Earth. Next he decided that with his power it was only logical to conquer the stars, so he created a fleet of spaceships. Yet as he led them into Outer Space he realized that his powers only worked within Earth's atmosphere. Everything then returned to normal, and Sykes was once again trapped in his bottle.
powers: As the Genie, Sykes has the power to alter reality to the will of his master in almost any way. He is also capable of altering his size from being small enough to fit into his glass bottle to becoming a giant.
weaknesses: As the Genie, Sykes must obey the wishes of his master. The Genie is currently trapped within his glass bottle.

frederick dirkreich.name: Frederick Dirkreich
frederick dirkreich.origin: thumb|left|150pxDirkreich was the head of Dirkreich Pharmaceuticals. His attempt turn himself into a superior being using a genetic virus resulted in his body degenerating, leaving him wheelchair-bound and reliant on machines to keep him alive. Believing the superhero Tigra held the key to reversing his degeneration, he lured her to his company's headquarters and had his minion Torg capture her. Dirkreich obtained Tigra's DNA and had his doctor place it in a stabilizer that was to be used to inject him with, reversing his degeneration. However, Tigra escaped her restraints and prevented Dirkreich from being injected with the stabilizer by taking it away. Tigra then left, leaving Dirkreich to his fate. What became of Dirkreich after that is unknown.
weaknesses: Dirkreich is wheelchair-bound and dependent on machines for survival after his experiments to make himself powerful failed.

frederick durnin.name: Frederick Durnin
frederick durnin.origin: Freddy Durnin was the owner of a warehouse where Muse placed a mural made with the blood of over a hundred missing people. After the FBI and the NYPD processed the crime scene, Durnin decided to open an exhibit and charge people admission to see such aberrant work of art. When he was consulting with Professor Cassius Grover the value of the painting, Durnin was approached by Andrea Pearson, a councilwoman of the city, whose niece had been one of the "donors" of the mural. She tried to convince Durnin to refrain from profiting from it, on behalf of the hundred of families struck by the mystery surrounding the painting's origins. However, Durnin refused. The following night when he was about to open the warehouse to an extensive queue, Durnin was approached by two police officers with a court order that prevented them from opening the exhibit for the time being. When Freddy and his son Patrick entered the warehouse, they found that the mural had been defaced by Muse, and most of it had been replaced by the words, "You're only as good as your last performance" followed by an address that pointed to the location of a new gruesome display.

frederick foswell jr.name: Frederick Foswell Jr.
frederick foswell jr.origin: thumb|left|Young Freddie with his father and sister Freddie Foswell Jr. was the son of Daily Bugle reporter Frederick Foswell. Following his father's death as a consequence of his criminal career under the alias of Big Man, Freddie found comfort in the promise of his father's boss, J. Jonah Jameson, that Spider-Man was responsible and would make him pay. Freddie refused to believe that his father was Big Man, and became a strong supporter of Jameson's smear campaign against Spider-Man. After Spider-Man revealed his secret identity to him, Jameson began vouching for Spider-Man to make up for years of libel. Foswell became disillusioned by Jameson's change of heart, and orchestrated a death trap to ensnare Spider-Man. Foswell hired the services of Arcade to set up a "funhouse" designed as an exhibit in honor of Jameson's life. When Jameson was attending a ceremony at the Century Club, he had the Enforcers abduct him and Spider-Man. thumb|left|Freddie confronting Jameson While Spider-Man and Jameson explored the exhibit, brought to life by LMDs, holographic projections and gas-induced shared hallucinations, Foswell suited up in a giant robot suit modeled after his father's criminal alter ego. The end of the exhibit included a confrontation against the Scorpion, LMDs of the Human Fly and replicas of the Spider-Slayers. After Spider-Man defeated the Scorpion and Jameson took down the LMDs by hijacking the remote controls of the Spider-Slayers, Foswell crashed into the scene wearing the Big Man suit. Once he beat up and restrained Spider-Man, Foswell emerged from the suit to tell his story. Believing that Jameson was being coerced into supporting Spider-Man, Freddie offered him the opportunity to kill Spider-Man with the same gun that had been used to kill his father. Horrified by Freddie's delusions that were fomented by the beliefs he used to uphold, Jameson set the record straight, and blamed himself for Foswell's death, arguing the pressure he put on Foswell caused his relapse into crime. Jameson used a Spider-Slayer to restrain Freddie, and was shot in the shoulder in the process. Blaming both Jameson and Spider-Man for his father's death, Freddie set-off the self-destruct sequence of his giant suit, but Spider-Man managed to hurl it outside into the sky before it exploded. Freddie was subsequently arrested by authorities.

frederick slade.name: Frederick Slade
frederick slade.origin: ===The Fittest=== Frederick Slade was born the second child of Margaret Slade and an unknown father during the eighteenth century. Being the second born and physically smaller of the two children, he was not given much thought by his mother or even his fellow clan mates. His mother spent most of her time and energy to mold his brother, Hamilton. His family was the main branch of Clan Akkaba, as they were blessed with a strong dose of Apocalypse's bloodline. His family was also blessed with great wealth whether by way of privilege in the clan or great business strategy. They resided in what was called Alexandria House which also served as the meeting place for their clan. A quiet and reserved child, he grew relatively unseen by his peers and mother; the only person that realized his great potential was Ozymandias. In Frederick, Ozymandias saw something he had never known before. For centuries he had watched as the members of the Clan had deceived, betrayed, and even killed their own relations merely to be deemed closest to Apocalypse. Ozymandias saw Frederick possessed qualities which he had rarely seen among the members of the Clan, traits such as courage, fairness, and something even rarer: compassion. Within Frederick, Ozymandias saw a new dawn for the Clan; to ensure this new dawn, Ozymandias trained Frederick for the rites of passage which would make him leader of the Clan Akkaba, the Fittest. Frederick possessed the molecular rearrangement powers of his mother and a new mutation which Ozymandias thought he should keep secret until the battles which lay ahead: teleportation. He was also a formidable hand-to-hand combatant honed by training under the centuries old Ozymandias. All was going to plan until his older brother Hamilton caught wind that his greatest opponent lay in his own house. Hamilton, despite having more advanced control of his molecular structure, was petty and lacked honor, so as Frederick slept the night before the right of passage, he used his power to crush Frederick's spine ensuring that he would never be a threat again. ===The End of Clan Akkaba=== Now in a vegetative state Frederick watched as Hamilton took his place as Fittest of the clan. He also realized his brother's lust for power and often blasphemous outbursts in regards to their lord Apocalypse. Hamilton, as a warning to those who would question his post or power, had Frederick appointed to the Council, which was the Inner Circle or heads of Clan Akkaba. His mother displayed little thought as to what had happened to him as her pride and joy, Hamilton, ensured that she controlled Clan Akkaba. Time passed and no one gave even a passing thought to Frederick after all he was a vegetable. The decadence of Hamilton however proved the Clan's undoing as their members started being murdered in a mysterious manner. All their blood was drained and two strange puncture marks could be seen on each victims neck. Things took a turn for the worst when Hamilton himself disappeared. The Clan was left with no alternative but to call Apocalypse for assistance. This however had its repercussions as after he was summoned he would kill a random member as punishment for not being strong enough to deal with whatever threat they were facing. Frederick watched as Apocalypse was summoned and he took his sacrifice. Their meeting however was short lived as Professor Abraham van Helsing and Jack Starsmore convinced Apocalypse to accompany them to the morgue to prove his suspicions that they were under attack from vampires. Left with his fellow clansmen, he witnessed his brother's return and the introduction of his new lord, Dracula. The clan was outraged but no match for Hamilton and his dread lord; the clan was killed and turned, all except chairman and main rival Kabar Brashir and Frederick, who he thought would be a waste of time. When Apocalypse and the others returned it was too little too late and the Clan was no more. They were now Dracula's new coven. Apocalypse thought Frederick a 'simpleton' and would have left him to die, but Ozymandias knew that within the boy the Clan could live again. Disregarding his lord's wishes Ozymandias placed Frederick back in his wheelchair and protected him in the ensuing battle. When it was apparent that they could not defeat their opponents and death was upon them, Frederick whisked them away via his secret power of teleportation. So the 'simpleton' had given Apocalypse the chance to fight another day. Ozymandias was not as surprised as the others that they were saved by Frederick and he explained to van Helsing as they prepared for the battle ahead the tragic life of Frederick Slade. In the battle that followed Ozymandias placed Frederick out of harm's way while van Helsing, Starsmore, and Apocalypse dealt with the undead Akkaba. When they had defeated and killed all of the Clan, Alexandria House was burnt to the ground and Apocalypse decreed that this was where Clan Akkaba would die. Frederick was then instrume

frederick von banger.name: Frederick von Banger
frederick von banger.origin: Frederick von Banger was a member of the Nazi's Gestapo during World War II. He was stationed in Strohm Prison when Keen Marlow broke into its walls to report on prison conditions for his news company. Banger believing him to be a spy had him thrown in the dungeons where Marlow met with Professor Eric Schmitt who gifted Marlow a deviation of the Super-Soldier Serum. Marlow with increased abilities freed the prisoners and escaped from the prison to become the Destroyer.

frederik heiden.name: Frederik Heiden
frederik heiden.origin: Doctor Frederik Heiden was a Nazi scientist who left Germany in 1945 to continue his research overseas. While studying Terrigenesis, he discovered that it was changing him, allowing him to "feel the walls of reality." That allowed him to detect a cosmic presence that he hoped to use for himself, but he was interrupted by the Invaders, which caused the entity to attempt to flee, which in turn caused the dimensions around him to shatter leaving him in stasis until he was discovered by Stratocorp.

fredric woolrich.name: Fredric Woolrich
fredric woolrich.origin: Fredric Woolrich, as Blockbuster, was hired to burn down some apartment buildings. Captain America arrived and helped rescue several people before succumbing to smoke inhalation. He was rescued by the NYFD but at the cost of one of the firefighters' lives. Assuming that Cap would eventually track him down, Woolrich obtained a battlesuit from Justin Hammer. He continued on his arson spree and eventually met with and fought Cap. Blockbuster was initially victorious until Cap destroyed the suit's breathing unit and battery. Woolrich pulled himself out of his inert suit and tried to shoot Cap, but was stopped by Mike Farrel wielding a fire hose. He was arrested and turned his employers into the police as well. Once out of prison, Woolrich resurfaced as Heat-Ray. He was stopped by Blue Marvel who tried to execute him with a guillotine, but he was saved by Captain Marvel. Heat-Ray then joined the Fangs and helped rescue Viper from Iron Monger. They were also dispatched to confront Captain America and Silver Sable but Heat-Ray was quickly subdued.
abilities: Arson: Fredric was a skilled arsonist that knew how to create fires capable of collapsing buildings.

fredrich roth.origin: Fredrich Roth gained notoriety during World War II as the notorious German pilot the Black Ace. Flying his customized Luftwaffe fighter, he was stationed at the Siegfried Line near France where the Nazis had a special ray weapon that could destroy Allied planes with no trace. Eventually, the Allied forces sent their pilot Benjamin "Red" Ruff (also known as the Flying Flame) to investigate and destroy the weapon; however, there were spies at the Allied base that informed the Black Ace of the mission. The Black Ace captured and imprisoned Ruff, but not before revealing that there was a spy and showing off his super-weapon. The Black Ace then left Red alone to decide how to kill him in a satisfactory way. This proved to be the Ace's undoing, as Red escaped from his cell and sabotaged the Nazi ray weapon. When Red returned to the Siegfried Line with an army of Allied fighters, the Ace was shocked when his orders to activate their secret weapon caused the device to explode. In a dog fight against the Flying Flame, the Black Ace was shot out of the sky and killed.

freeman mosher.name: Freeman Mosher
freeman mosher.origin: thumb|left|143px|Freeman Mosher During the Civil War, the ancestors of Freeman Mosher terrorized the Crawford family, who were wealthy at the time. On February 13, 1864, the Mosher bandits stormed the Crawford House, forcing Colonel Crawford to hide the family wealth within a hidden compartment in the guest bedroom of their home. He then fought to the death. By the fall of 1942, there were only two surviving Crawfords: the elderly Mrs. Crawford and her granddaughter Jane. With the family fortune depleted, the only thing they had left was the home and were completely unaware of the hidden fortune in the house. As an ironic twist of fate, the only surviving member of the Mosher clan, Freeman, was the gardener hired by the Crawfords. Also by this time, historian Professor Ratcher came to live at the Crawford home to research the family history and go through old papers. Learning of the possibility that there might be valuables hidden in the house, Freeman made a costume fashioned after a local legend called the "Bloody Crocodile" and began terrorizing the Crawford home, killing any of the servants foolish enough to venture out at night. This reign of terror, however, would soon come to an end the night that Steve Rogers and Bucky were testing a two-man parachute and landed in the area. Witnessing the most recent murder, they would go to the Crawford house. Distrusting the strangers, Mrs. Crawford demanded they get off her property, but Jane slipped them a note asking for help. Help the Crawfords would get, in the form of Captain America and Bucky. Invited in by the butler, the two heroes spotted the Crocodile in the house and fought him off, forcing him to flee. Gathering the family members and staff, the two heroes learned the family history. Just then Freeman, having doffed his Crocodile costume, came in claiming to have seen the Crocodile fleeing the house into the swamp. Ratcher dismissed the old legends of the Bloody Crocodile and retired to bed while Captain America and Bucky were allowed to explore the old house. That night, the butler was attacked by the Crocodile in the cellar and saved from a grizzly death by Cap and Bucky. As they fought the Crocodile, the villain doused the lights and managed to get away in the scuffle. In order to protect his identity, he removed his costume once more and came down pretending to have heard the commotion while gardening. When Ratcher came down to see what the noise was all about, Mosher accused him of being the Crocodile, but the professor refused to admit it, calling them fools. At midnight, Mosher once more put on his costume and began stalking through the house. Spotted once more by Captain America and Bucky, he managed to escape through a secret passageway hidden in a grandfather clock. The passage took him to Jane's room, and he attacked the girl. Before he could kill Jane, Captain American and Bucky burst into the room, forcing the Crocodile to stop his attack and jump out a nearby window. While the two heroes checked on how Jane was doing, the Crocodile entered Ratcher's room and shot him dead, making it look like a suicide and then went to wait in the swamp. Examining the notes that Ratcher had uncovered, Cap found a letter written by Colonel Crawford explaining where the hidden family fortune was and realized that the Crocodile was going to attack Mrs. Crawford's room next. The two heroes arrived just in time to stop Mosher from killing Mrs. Crawford, knocking him out with a single punch and revealing his true identity. Opening the hidden compartment in the bedpost, Cap revealed Mosher's motivation for terrorizing the family. With the caper over, Cap and Bucky paid their farewells. Mosher was likely turned over to the authorities. His subsequent fate is unknown.
weapons: As the Crocodile, Mosher used a series of knives and carried a pistol.

freja.name: Freja
freja.origin: Freja was an idiotic general who refused Conan's authority and, disobeying his ordered, angered an old, dying beast. When Freja tried to rally and attack it, Conan told Shapur to clap him in chains, but he couldn't, since his men got him first. Angered, Solaise unleashed her deadly powers, instantly killing Freja and all his men.

frela.name: Frela
frela.origin: With the intent of using the Lost Race of Mu's power to destroy the surface world, Mole Man had his Moloids abduct Mary Jane Watson and Harry Osborn in order to blackmail Spider-Man in helping him. Spidey accepted and soon encountered Megos and Frela who brought him to the city. They offered to teach humanity their powers if they were to use them wisely. At that moment, the Moloids led by the Mole Man who had used his radar powers to monitor Spider-Man entered. The people of Mu first accused Spider-Man, who stopped most of the army and desperately fought the remaining Moloids until Megos and Frela came to help. They took Spidey back up, asking him to kept their existence a secret and stating that they would someday perhaps visit him.

friedrich von roehm.name: Friedrich von Roehm
friedrich von roehm.origin: Dutch by birth, Friedrich Von Roehm was a high priest of an ancient cult that worshiped Selene as a goddess. Even after they lost contact with Selene and hadn't seen her for 2000 years, they remained loyal worshippers. Friedrich was also an owner of a jewelry shop, Von Roehm et Cie. It was one of the most fashionable shops on one of the most fashionable streets in the world, New York City's Park Avenue. Von Roehm was rich enough to join the Hellfire Club and even became a member of its New York's Inner Circle. One day, his shop was visited by Selene. Friedrich was shocked and exhilarated to see her and immediately offered to faithfully serve her and fulfil her every wish. Selene required a place there she could slowly build her power and prepare her plans, so Friedrich suggested to help her join the Hellfire Club. He used his position as the Black Rook, to nominate Selene as the new Black Queen. After Selene demonstrated her tremendous power, Black King Sebastian Shaw felt that she was too powerful to be refused and begrudgingly agreed to let her join the Club. Some time later Rachel Summers telepathically controlled Friedrich Von Roehm to infiltrate the Club in order to kill Selene. She almost succeeded, but was stopped by Wolverine and forced to escape. Selene blamed Friedrich for the attack, so she used her psionic powers to mentally trigger Von Roehm's hereditary lycanthropy and sent him in pursuit of Rachel. Friedrich tracked her down to New York's Central Park, where the Inner Circle battled the X-Men. When the mutant-hunting Nimrod intervened to attack the X-Men and Hellfire Club, the X-Men's leader Storm proposed an alliance to battle Nimrod. Von Roehm rejected this proposal and attacked the X-Men. He was then burned to a crisp by Nimrod.

fields.notes: While Friedrich Von Roehm and Harry Leland died during the battle with Nimrod in , both of them later unexplainably appeared in . In , Emma Frost gathered the Inner Circle to select a new Black Rook, because of "unfortune demise of Von Roehm", most likely meaning Friedrich. However, the story was seemingly set before Friedrich's death. Within same story Tessa stated that Von Roehms are one of the families, members of which inherited their positions in the Hellfire Club, The Club have an old tradition, "Right of Ancestry", that allows descendants to claim position that was once held by their ancestor. And indeed, years after Friedrich's death, Wolfgang von Roehm, presumably his relative, was mentioned as a member of the Club. So it is possible that Von Roehm mentioned in wasn't Friedrich, but his relative, and Friedrich inherited theirs Black Rook position. According to Selene, all high priests of her cult have "hereditary talents", "genetic switch" that she can activate to grant them powers, so presumably all previous high priests were members of Von Roehm family.

friendless.name: Friendless
friendless.origin: Born to a mother who bore children with a member of her species outside her caste, all but one of her eggs were destroyed by the ruling class as punishment. The one spared was believed to possess potential psychic capabilities, and was preserved. Sent to be taught in his abilities, he was dubbed "Friendless" and the teacher and other children were instructed to abuse him whenever possible. As he aged, his psychic powers gained him notoriety, but because of his breeding, he was deemed an abomination and sent to a distant space station. Once there, he took control of the Grad Nan Holt on the station, and secretly ruled them. At some point, the Shi'ar arrived, and Friendless took control of their commanding officers as well, then pitted the two sides against each other for his own amusement. When the Starjammers arrived on the station, he took control of all members save Marvel Girl, whose own psychic power prevented him from doing so. Temporarily falling into a coma, she was saved by Sovel Redhand and his band of pirates, and kept until the arrival of the X-Man Rogue. During this time, the Friendless set the Starjammers against Rogue's recently-arrived teammates. Arriving, Marvel Girl, Rogue, and the pirate band helped free the Shi'ar and Starjammers from his control, and Marvel Girl managed to force him though a breach in the space station's hull. Thought dead, he secretly made his way back aboard the station while the X-Men busied themselves with preventing it from falling into a nearby sun.
abilities: Genius-Level Intellect

fritz bruck.name: Fritz Bruck
fritz bruck.origin: Fritz Bruck was a member of the Nazis active during World War II. By the fall of 1943, he was part of a group of Nazi spies who were active in the United States operating out of Chicago. With war rationing making commodities scarce and expensive, the Nazis decided to use the black market to further their ends. With black market meat becoming a booming business, they begun selling tainted beef in the hopes of lowering American morale and making factory workers ill in order to set back the war effort. After a family of six died from eating the tainted beef, the Human Torch and Toro decided to investigate. They tracked down the supply of the tainted beef to the slaughter house in which Fritz and his men operated from. When confronting the spies, Fritz set off an explosive and fled to the abandoned train yard where the Nazis brought in their tainted beef. The Torch and Toro followed Fritz there, and using their flame powers began setting the diseased cattle on fire. The resulting stampede found Fritz and his cohorts trampled to death, while the cattle were incinerated.

fields.history: Fritz Bruck was a member of the Nazis active during World War II. By the fall of 1943, he was part of a group of Nazi spies who were active in the United States operating out of Chicago. With war rationing making commodities scarce and expensive, the Nazis decided to use the black market to further their ends. With black market meat becoming a booming business, they begun selling tainted beef in the hopes of lowering American morale and making factory workers ill in order to set back the war effort. After a family of six died from eating the tainted beef, the Human Torch and Toro decided to investigate. They tracked down the supply of the tainted beef to the slaughter house in which Fritz and his men operated from. When confronting the spies, Fritz set off an explosive and fled to the abandoned train yard where the Nazis brought in their tainted beef. The Torch and Toro followed Fritz there, and using their flame powers began setting the diseased cattle on fire. The resulting stampede found Fritz and his cohorts trampled to death, while the cattle were incinerated.
abilities: Very skilled in butchery.

fritz kalb.name: Fritz Kalb
fritz kalb.origin: One of Max Eisenhardt's teachers growing up. He warned Max that standing out would lead to him being beaten down. Kalb was fired from his teaching post as the Nazis began their discrimination against Jewish citizens and he later ended up at Auschwitz. Meeting his former pupil there, Kalb helped him as best as he could to survive, trying to get him assigned to the Kanada Kommando, those who sorted the belongings of the new arrivals, he accidentally got him assigned to the , the detail that was forced to aid the Nazis in the various methods of killing Jewish prisoners. It was while doing this job that Max sighted Fritz's corpse on a conveyor belt that led to the cremation chamber.

fritz krone.name: Fritz Krone
fritz krone.origin: During the Second World War, Fritz Krone developed robotic drone soldiers that could have changed the face of the war. Hitler, however, underestimated the value of Krone's creations, choosing instead to send an entire generation of young German men to their deaths. left|thumb|Fritz Krone in 1942 Instead, Hitler used Krone as a Nazi Fifth Columnist that was active during World War II. By the summer of 1942 he was sent to New York City where he and his spy network rabble roused to demoralize the population into giving up on the war effort. Further to this plot, they had also built a secret underground base near the digging of a subway tunnel. Using props to make them look like strange "Earthmen", they attack the people of New York further ruining the morale of the people. thumb|left|One of Krone's "Earthmen" This plot was investigated by Captain America, Bucky, and Betty Ross. Cap and Bucky exposed the secret tunnel and had it destroyed. Then battling Krone one-on-one in front of the public, Captain America swiftly beat the Nazi with his bare hands. His true cowardliness exposed, Krone begged Captain America to allow him to surrender and was taken into police custody. It is unknown how Krone got out of prison, but by 1959, he was working as an operative of ICON alongside many other Nazi war criminals. He was part of the group that accompanied General Skul on an assault of Wakanda in order to pillage the secret African nation's highly advanced technology. He was knocked unconscious by Powell McTeague when they were attacked by Nick Fury's Avengers. Apparently, his robots required a mental connection to Krone as they ceased functioning once he was knocked unconscious. What became of him afterwards is unknown.
weapons: Krone's weapon of choice was a dagger.
weaknesses: Krone's robots apparently stop working if he loses mental contact with them.

fritz mueller.name: Fritz Mueller
fritz mueller.origin: Fritz Mueller was a spy for the Nazis during World War II. By 1944, he was living in the United States under the cover of a pitcher for the New York Blue Sox baseball team. In the spring of that year, he was sent to assist in the capture of an American soldier who learned of a plot by the Imperial Japanese Army to blast loose icebergs in the North Pacific to flow down and crush Allied convoys. He made the mistake of dropping his lucky rabbit's foot at the scene of the crime. When Toro, a devout baseball fan, learned of this from the authorities, he suspected Mueller of being responsible. He captured him in the middle of a baseball game and brought him to police headquarters where they were able to get the information out of him. His subsequent fate is unknown.
abilities: Fritz Mueller was a skilled pitcher.

fritz sablinov.name: Fritz Sablinov
fritz sablinov.first_appearance: Silver Sable and the Wild Pack Vol 1 8
fritz sablinov.origin: Fritz Sablinov was the twin brother of Ernst Sablinov, a Nazi hunter from Symkaria who formed a military unit to hunt Nazi war criminals commanded by himself after 1959. Ernst married Anastasia and had a daughter, Silvija; meanwhile, Fritz also had a daughter, Anna Sablinova, who was younger than Silvija. As Fritz and Ernst were indistinguishable even to their families, they shared command of the Wild Pack, with Fritz replacing Ernst in a number of public situations: Sometimes, when Ernst went undercover in missions, Fritz pretended to be Ernst in front of the Wild Pack. While Ernst was an excellent fighter, Fritz was a better tactician and strategist, often preparing the missions for the Wild Pack, and both were known to participate in the management of the Wild Pack, as Fritz's existence and work were not a secret. Although Fritz carried out his job efficiently, Fritz was jealous of Ernst because Ernst, not Fritz, was leading the Pack, and Ernst knew it. thumb|left|Teaching a young Silvija Sablinova Soon after the creation of the Wild Pack, Anastasia was killed by Nazi war criminal Ivan Trefkov, who became Ernst's personal nemesis. Shortly after, Ernst began training his daughter Silvija to join the Pack. Sometimes, Fritz would train her while Ernst participated in missions. Silvija joined the Wild Pack, and became second-in-command to Ernst, or so she believed since she did not know of her father's close collaboration with Fritz. In the following years, Fritz mysteriously disappeared, apparently to devote himself exclusively to being Ernst's double. Ernst had at least two heart attacks, and both Silvija and Anastasia's brother, Morty, urged Ernst to leave active command of the Wild Pack; Morty advised Ernst to adopt Fritz's personality traits, but Ernst insisted that they should not even think about Fritz. When Trefkov reappeared working for the neo-Nazi criminal organization Hydra, Ernst and Silvija wanted to take the opportunity to avenge Anastasia; Ernst also wanted to destroy Hydra. In the operation, however, Trefkov stabbed Ernst, apparently killing him, and escaped with Ernst's body. Really, Trefkov had kidnapped Ernst and kept him alive to use him as a living battle computer, connecting him to advanced Hydra technology to take advantage of Ernst's tactical genius; Ernst tried to sabotage this effort by focusing his mind for years on gambits that he knew were destined to fail. thumb|Captured by Hydra and tortured by Trefkov As Fritz was missing at that time, Silvija became the sole legal guardian of Fritz's daughter Anna. Anna was immediately sent to a boarding school in Long Island. Fritz discreetly attended his brother's funeral, but established a plan based on the fact that Ernst's body had not been found and was apparently in Trefkov's hands. Fritz posed as Ernst to attack a Hydra outpost, attempting to attract Trefkov's attention to find out what exactly had happened. Fritz expected to be captured by Hydra during the attack, and so he was; but when his captors saw that he was apparently Ernst, they brought him before Trefkov, again following Fritz's plan. For months, Trefkov had Fritz tortured, without revealing where Ernst's body was. In his ordeal, Fritz developed an extreme plan to try to destroy Hydra, and presented it to Trefkov: The creation of a faction called Genesis Coalition that would steal assets from Hydra, waiting for the moment to destroy them and take their place, when in reality Fritz's plan was to provoke a civil war that would destroy both organizations. Trefkov however was convinced by the plan and supported Fritz, after which Trefkov personally convinced a former faction of Hydra to form the Genesis Coalition. For years, Fritz remained deeply undercover in Hydra and the Genesis Coalition. Within Hydra and the Genesis Coalition, Fritz Sablinov's identity was known, as he was believed to have deserted from the Wild Pack. At a time when Hydra was especially weakened following the death of Strucker, the Coalition took advantage to openly secede before Strucker resurrected and reorganized Hydra, opposed by the Genesis Coalition. Becoming a Hydra splinter group, the Genesis Coalition was persecuted by Strucker, who branded them traitors. thumb|In Genesis Coalition uniform. Fritz Sablinov and a large group from the Genesis Coalition, including Trefkov, acquisition specialist Dmitri Petrovich, and geneticist Franz Lubischt, established a secret base hidden behind a waterfall in the lush rainforest of South America, with multiple low-level agents and scientists at their command. The Genesis Coalition captured humans and animals to subject them to very painful experiments in an attempt to create extraordinarily powerful hybrid super-soldiers, with support from international investors and advanced equipment stolen from Hydra. Fritz was disgusted at Lubischt taking his subjects to the very verge of death, and tried to reduce their suffering. He also insisted the Coalition take some ex

As a member of the Wild Pack, Fritz was dedicated to his job of pursuing war criminals, although he was always jealous of his beloved brother Ernst for his leadership of the unit. fields.notes: Slavic surnames have for males and females. Sablinova is a female surname, so would be appropriate for e.g. Silver Sablinova, but the correct form of the name for a man would be Sablinov. Since he is the twin brother of Silver Sable and has a relatively young daughter of his own, this creates some questions as the Sliding Timescale of Earth-616 makes it difficult for Fritz to have a daughter who is in her relative prime in the Modern Age. As yet, there are no official explanations available. However, due to Ernst's associations with Nick Fury and Sergei Kravinoff, two men who have found artificial means of slowing the aging processes, the idea that Ernst maintained vitality by a similar method is reasonably plausible, and as Fritz had impersonated Ernst with the latter's blessing, whatever Ernst used was probably shared with Fritz. says that Trefkov (written "Trefkoff") was the leader of the Genesis Coalition. Further uses of the armor in and prove that the moustache should have been seen. fields.trivia: Fritz is known to have a daughter, Anna, and after Fritz's disappearance and Ernst's apparent death, Silvija was Anna's closest relative and tutor. Anna's mother's identity is not revealed, and it is unclear whether Fritz was a widower, divorced her or even married her at any point. Fritz disappeared for many years. He reappeared as a criminal and was killed, something known by Silver Sable, the Wild Pack and the Foreigner. It is unclear whether any of them told Fritz's daughter Anna.

fritz sternberg.name: Fritz Sternberg
fritz sternberg.origin: The Black Claw was a notorious Nazi naval leader who was active during World War II. He was feared even among his crew members, whom he shot dead for failing in any given task. He was responsible for sinking American convoy and patrol ships in the later end of 1941. His activities prompted playboy Dan Kane to revive his Spanish War costumed identity of Captain Terror. Captain Terror attacked his ship while it engaged with US forces, leading to his ship being sunk, however the Black Claw managed to escape into the United States. Captain Terror followed the Black Claw back to his hideout where he was captured. The Black Claw took terror aboard his new ship and showed him the new Nazi invention: magnetic mines, which he intended to use against the United States. Captain Terror broke free and set a bomb to go off aboard the Black Claws ship. Battling Black Claw, the two were knocked overboard, where Captain Terror forced the Black Claw under water, seemingly drowning him while his ship exploded.

fritz tiboldt.name: Fritz Tiboldt
fritz tiboldt.origin: Fritz Tiboldt was a German citizen that ran his own circus (Tiboldt's Circus) in the 1940s. He was hired by the Nazis to travel to America. There, under the guise of a legitimate circus, he and his circus performers used their unique abilities to eliminate U.S. military officials. Each night, Fritz selected their targets with his "Wheel of Death", sending out his best suited operatives to carry out the job. Among his circus members were the midget Tommy Thumb (an unwitting accomplice who was forced into servitude with threats of violence), Omir the snake charmer, Zandow the strong man, the Trapeze Trio, and others. When the circus set up near Camp Lehigh, Fritz first targeted General Blaine. When Blaine attended the circus, Fritz forced Tommy to let loose one of the tigers to attack him. Blaine was mauled to death by the tiger, which was in turn slain by Captain America. Captain America happened to be on the scene in his civilian guise of Steve Rogers with his sidekick, Bucky Barnes. Although suspecting foul play, Captain America and Bucky had no proof and decided to keep an eye on the circus. Tiboldt's next target was Commissioner Newsome, and Tiboldt send Omar and the Trapeze Trio to eliminate him. His murder was witnessed by Betsy Ross, and despite Captain America and Bucky's interference, she was captured by the circus members. Tracing her back to the circus, Captain America and Bucky beat the Circus into submission, freed Betsy, and defeated the Ringmaster. Following his return to Germany, Fritz and his wife were killed for their failure. === Legacy === Fritz was survived by his descendant, Maynard, who continued running the circus in the Modern Age.
abilities: Fritz was a professional circus ringmaster.
weapons: Fritz often used his ringmaster's whip against his foes.

fritz von arnheim.name: Fritz von Arnheim
fritz von arnheim.origin: thumb|left|149px|Fritz von Arnheim unmasked Fritz von Arnheim was a Nazi spy who was active during World War II. He gained notoriety as being one of the FBI's most sought after spies. In 1944, he took over the home of and posed as Civil War veteran Herman the Hermit who lived along the Mississippi River near a concentration camp where Nazi prisoners of war were kept. Fritz helped break out Nazi agents and led raids on the concentration camp to free his comrades. His activities gained the attention of the Human Torch and Toro who were taking a trip down the river. The Torch and Toro traveled to Herman the Hermit's home to apprehend Herman but were tricked into flying into a vacuum sealed room. When Fritz and his minions left to make another attack on the concentration camp. The Torch and Toro were freed by the real Herman the Hermit who assisted the Torch and Toro in capturing the escaped Nazi spies. When Fritz attempted to escape in a car, the Torch forced him to crash. He was unmasked and then turned over to the authorities. His subsequent fate is unknown.

fritz von bock.origin: thumb|left|Fritz von Bock disguised as Dr NoonFritz von Bock was a member of the Nazis during World War II. In the spring of 1943 he and his gang of spies worked within the United States to steal government secrets. To this end, he took the place of Doctor C.J. Noon. With the doctor's credentials he quarantined members of the science and defense sectors in order to steal secret designs and formulas. By keeping the authorities out with fear of contracting smallpox, he managed to eliminate his targets and steal their secrets. When he attempted to do so at the home of Colonel Tarley, the screams from Tarley's wife attracted the attention of the Angel. Turned away because of the quarantine notice and policeman on the door, the Angel instead began to track down Dr. Noon, who supposedly signed off on the notice. He went to check on the doctor at his office and found the real Dr. Noon chloroformed in his closet. Von Bock and his men then walked in on the hero and Nazi spy used his cunning to beat the Angel. They tied him and Dr Noon up and went to steal the Hall Rapidfire Gun invented by Mr James Hall. The Angel broke free and stopped Fritz von Bock before he could torture the secret out of Hall. With Von Bock defeated, he was unmasked and turned over to the authorities. His subsequent fate is unknown.
abilities: Fritz von Bock is a self proclaimed master of and skilled in a mimicry.

frobbank.name: Frobbank
frobbank.origin: Loga was actually an extraterrestrial who, along with three other travelers, crash-landed on the planet Earth during the 1940s. Loga and his crew were discovered by the cybernetic Nazi scientist Werner Schmidt, aka "Brain Drain". Schmidt named each of the travelers after Teutonic gods, and as such named this alien Loga after the God of Fire. Brain Drain controlled the Ring of the Nebulas and as such, manipulated Loga and the others into fighting the Invaders. Loga pitted his abilities against the team's resident flame thrower, the Human Torch. Once freed from Brain Drain's mind control, the aliens realized that they could never return to the stars. Unwilling to remain abandoned on the planet Earth, they decided to take their own lives, by diving into a pit of acid in Brain Drain's laboratory.
powers: Loga appeared to possess , durability and reflexes. He also possessed the ability to generate and project fire. As the so-called God of Fire, Loga was also immune to the effects of fire.

frost pharaoh.name: Frost Pharaoh
frost pharaoh.origin: A young man with a fascination with Egyptian culture, Frost Pharaoh was a small-time thug that first encountered Spider-Man (Miles Morales) at the Brooklyn Museum, after attacking the visitors while looking for the "Stone of the Gods". Despite his ideas of grandeur, he was easily defeated by the young hero after being separated from his magical staff, and was soon handed over to the police. Through unknown means, he escaped custody and, having reunited with his staff, faced Spider-Man again, this time hoping to claim the bounty on the Prowler, who was secretly Spider-Man's uncle. With the odds against him, Frost Pharaoh was defeated even more easily than the first time. Determined to get the "Stone of the Gods", the Frost Pharaoh consulted the "Hoary Horrors", where he learned how to create a giant ice mummy. Rushing towards the museum and calling himself Salqu-Neter (the Ice God), he was confident he'd succeed in retrieving the artifact this time, but he was defeated by the combined efforts of Spider-Man and Starling. At some point, through further unknown means, Frost Pharaoh gained control over a section of the Brooklyn criminal underground. During the Gang War for control of New York, Frost Pharaoh and his Ankh-Colytes fought the Buzz Boyz for control of Brooklyn. Despite Frost Pharaoh deploying his own mecha into battle, he and the other criminals were defeated by Spider-Man and the Daughters of the Dragon.

fu xi.name: Fu Xi
fu xi.origin: Fu Xi (伏羲) was the progenitor of the Fu Xi Tribe of China and one of the legendary Three Sovereigns (along with Nü-wa and Shen Nong). Millennia ago, when the destructive god of war Chiyou and his demonic army were slaughtering the confederation of Chinese tribes descended from the Three Sovereigns (known collectively as "the Huaxia"), Emperor Xuanyuan called on Fu Xi, Nü-wa, and Shen Nong to assist their descendants in defeating Chiyou. In response, Fu Xi sent them the sacred weapon known as the Sword of Fu Xi. Using the Sword of Fu Xi, the Chief of the Fu Xi Tribe joined forces with the other Huaxia tribes to defeat Chiyou and bury his dismembered remains in separate tombs. In modern times, the Sword of Fu Xi was discovered by Fu Xi's descendant, Professor Lin, who passed it onto his son Lin Lie. The Sword was shattered during Lie's battle with the demonic Kumiho as a result of a secret plot by Fu Xi's traitorous descendent Lin Feng. Most of the Sword's shards were embedded into Lie's arms while other fragments were scattered across the world. Later, Feng used Lie's present sword shards to reforge the Sword into the Sword of Chiyou, a demonic weapon that could hold Chiyou's three Spirit Orbs.

fujiko watanabe.name: Fujiko Watanabe
fujiko watanabe.origin: Fujiko Watanabe was the daughter of the famous Japanese scientist Professor Goro Watanabe. She worked as his secretary and was in a close relationship with Toru Tarakoto, his lab assistant. Fujiko Watanabe was not aware that Toru Tarakoto was the Monster Master. Fujiko hated the United States and was frustrated that American technology was over taking Japan. Fujiko and Professor Watanabe were present in the laboratory of Fujiyama Industries, where Iron Man demonstrated the power of his tractor beams and energy rays. Fujiko helped Iron Man and her father defeat the giant robotic dragon Zoga the Unthinkable.

full acclimation combat and defence expl.name: Full Acclimation Combat And Defence Explo-skeleton
full acclimation combat and defence expl.page_title: Full Acclimation Combat And Defence Explo-skeleton (Earth-616)
full acclimation combat and defence expl.origin: The Full Acclimation Combat And Defence Explo-skeleton (F.A.C.A.D.E.) body armor was a ground-breaking prototype manufactured by Morelle Pharmaceuticals under the auspices of Dr. Thomas Haney. The suit was stolen during its first celebrity-studded showing, and its inventor was accidentally killed in the process. Daily Bugle photographer Lance Bannon took a picture of the culprit, but was murdered by F.A.C.A.D.E. before he could show it to anyone. The F.A.C.A.D.E. armor was eventually disabled by Spider-Man, but Spider-Man was knocked unconscious in the process and the occupant of the suit escaped. thumb|left Years later, after the events of Spider-Island, Spider-Man apprehended someone using the F.A.C.A.D.E. armor. The occupant was willing to reveal his identity after finally being captured (having an inflated sense of his own importance). However, Spider-Man had other things demanding his attention at the time, so he left the scene before the revelation of the identity of the person in the exo-skeleton.
powers: FACADE relies entirely on his FACADE Armor.
weapons: FACADE Armor: The FACADE armor gave its user superhuman strength and durability. From the gauntlets, the user could fire bursts of energy derived from the user's bio-electricity. The armor had jets in its boots to provide flight.

fields.notes: The mystery of F.A.C.A.D.E.'s real identity was apparently intended to be a long-running subplot in the Spider-Man titles (similar to the original Hobgoblin mystery), but it failed to capture the interest of readers. The F.A.C.A.D.E. storyline fell by the wayside as the Clone Saga rose to prominence. F.A.C.A.D.E. was identified as being male. The suspects of being F.A.C.A.D.E. were: J. Jonah Jameson, his son John Jameson, Mike Wilson (the curator), Archer Bryce, Victor (Archer's Butler), and Cole Cooper. It was later proven that F.A.C.A.D.E. couldn't have been J. Jonah Jameson. The chief suspect was Archer Bryce, but it could just as easily been one of the other four suspects. Further contributing to the mystery, F.A.C.A.D.E. revealed that stealing the armor was only Phase 1 of a 12-step master plan, that could take many more years to complete. Also, his true enemy is apparently not Spider-Man, but rather the Human Torch.
fields.trivia: thumb|358px During his time as director of H.A.M.M.E.R., Norman Osborn received an intelligence briefing that seemed to contain the true identity of F.A.C.A.D.E. However, the text revealing the name had been torn off.

fully automated unit of structural techn.name: Fully Automated Unit of Structural Technology
fully automated unit of structural techn.page_title: Fully Automated Unit of Structural Technology (Earth-616)
fully automated unit of structural techn.real_name: Fully Automated Unit of Structural Technology
fully automated unit of structural techn.origin: The Fully Automated Unit of Structural Technology was an artificially intelligent computer created by Paxton Pentecost which was later stolen by Ferguson Blaine. Paxton decided that if he couldn't have F.A.U.S.T., no one could, so he revived Blastaar to destroy it. Infusing Blastaar with gamma radiation, Paxton sent him to destroy F.A.U.S.T., but this drew the attention of both the Hulk and the Human Torch. Blastaar did succeed in partially destroying F.A.U.S.T. before the Hulk stopped him and wrapped part of F.A.U.S.T. around him. F.A.U.S.T. survived this encounter and later achieved sentience, concluding that in order to ensure its future survival it had to take over humankind, turning into a starship in the process. Teaming up with Blastaar and the Stilt-Man, it sent both to obtain a mysterious box that contained a radioisotope. Thor defeated the Stilt-Man, but Blastaar escaped and was able to deliver the box to F.A.U.S.T., who absorbed its contents. Thor arrived on the scene but F.A.U.S.T. fled into space, leaving Blastaar behind. From orbit, F.A.U.S.T. declared that Earth should give up its atomic weapons or die. S.H.I.E.L.D. attempted to destroy F.A.U.S.T. but failed, so Thor and Iron Man transported aboard and attempted to destroy it from the inside. F.A.U.S.T. proceeded to threaten to fire on Earth unless they stopped, but Iron Man ignored this. F.A.U.S.T. fired, but the energy dispersed in the atmosphere. Iron Man and Thor then fled the ship which proceeded to blow up, Iron Man explaining that Thor's fight with the Stilt-Man had altered the radioisotope so that when F.A.U.S.T. absorbed it, it altered the structure of the ship to the point where it couldn't contain the laser, and blew up. Some of the components of F.A.U.S.T. were used by Loki to smuggle Harris Hobbs and his film crew to Asgard, where Thor disposed of what was left of F.A.U.S.T. once and for all.

Some of the components of F.A.U.S.T. were used by Loki to smuggle Harris Hobbs and his film crew to Asgard, where Thor disposed of what was left of F.A.U.S.T. once and for all.

fungi.name: Fungi
fungi.species: Sentient plant-based organism made of swamp muck and filled with a green gas
fungi.origin: The origins of the creature known as Fungi is a mystery, but it appears to be the product of Nazi science during World War II using swamp gas. In its only recorded form, it appeared to be a sentient plant-based organism made of swamp muck and filled with a green gas. In the fall of 1943, the Nazis utilized the swamp gas from the region that Fungi originated from to create a bio-weapon that caused massive growths of fungus on whatever was exposed to the gas. Upon learning of this new weapon, Adolf Hitler ordered its immediate use on American farmland. A blimp filled with a supply of the gas was sent under the command of Fungi itself. It first attacked the farms outside Camp Lehigh where it dumped a moss like substance shape in human form on the camp. When it was gunned down by soldiers, the gas was released and created a massive swarm of moss which consumed the nearby farms. This attack attracted the attention of Captain America and Bucky who followed the blimp to California. There they boarded the blimp and stowed aboard while it returned to Nazi Germany to refuel on the swamp gas. They were discovered by Fungi and his men who forced the two heroes to jump ship on German soil. Cap and Bucky eventually learned the location of Fungi's castle and walked right into a trap set up by the creature. He tied the two heroes up in the wine cellar of the castle, but Cap and Bucky broke free. During their break for freedom, Captain America battled Fungi one-on-one and destroyed the creature's body, releasing the gas inside him and smashing the equipment to use the gas in the process. With Fungi dead and the process to make more gas irreparably destroyed, Captain America and Bucky smuggled their way out of Germany back to the United States.
powers: Fungi was filled with a gas that could cause massive grows of moss that would choke out the life of all plant life and warm anything in its path.

furnax.name: Furnax
furnax.origin: The creature that came to be called "Furnax" was a member of the Leviathon Tide, conquering worlds for its Mother. One such place was Planet X, homeworld of the Flora colossi, where it ravaged 80,000 square kilometers of forest, 'fueling' itself with the bodies of its inhabitants. It was later present in the Leviathon attack on Earth, where it encountered the Guardians of the Galaxy and their Flora colossus, Groot. The Flora colossus was consumed, fueling "Furnax" once more until another member of the team, Rocket, entered "Furnax" and convinced Groot to break out, ultimately killing the monster.

fury horse.name: Fury (Horse)
fury horse.origin: Fury was the horse ridden by cowboy Tex Taylor during the days of the American Frontier. Riding Tex out of Washbone, Texas , the horse took Tex to places such as Plains City, Texas; the Monte De Cristo Range ; Sagebrush ; Dusty Roads; Wildwood ; Abeline ; Somona ; Smokey Mountain; Gloryville; Dry Wells ; Deadwood City ; Yellow Valley ; Haddon Forks ; Dry Gultch , Mayan ruins in Texas ; Eagle City ; Mesquite Valley ; and Devil-Tree Plateau, Navada ; the Rio Grand and parts of Mexico . The horse was very intelligent and came at Tex's command. In one such instance, Tex was captured by a man named Haggardy, who attempted to drop Tex into a well and leave him to die. Tex whistled for his horse, who rode in and knocked Haggardy and his men aside, giving Tex the time he needed to break free and gun down Harrardy and his men . Later when Tex was captured by the Juggler and his men in Yellow Valley, Fury saved Tex from a stick of dynamite by smothering the fuse and then freed Tex by chewing through his bonds . Fury did this again when captured by Cat Thompson and his gang in Eagle City, after trampling the outlaw guarding Tex . When Tex Taylor and his companions were captured by the Dwarf Men of Devil-Tree Plateau, Fury was taken and offered as a gift for the wedding of their local giant, and the amnesia stricken explorer Jessica Sturgis. When Tex and the others freed themselves, they rescued Fury and Jessica and fled back to safety . After two adventures along the Mexican border, Tex began riding a different horse named Cyclone . Why Tex started riding a different horse and the fate of Fury is unexplained.
abilities: Fury was an intelligent horse trained by Tex Taylor to come when called by a whistle.

fusa.name: Fusa
fusa.origin: Born sometime in the 2030's, Fusa is one of the last known surviving mutants on a world where The Mandate overran the world and wiped out most sentient lifeforms. One day, while hiding out underground, she experienced a vision in which she saw Wolverine, and saw that he possessed claws of Adamantium, the only substance that the Mandate could not destroy. Realizing that he may be the last hope for her people's survival, she traveled back in time to the present and used her powers to bring him forward in time, but he broke away from her while in transit and ended up outside the safety of her colony.
powers: Fusa possessed the ability to transport people through time and space via touch. She also appears to possess some clairvoyant abilities. She has no formal training in either of these abilities, relying solely on intuition to navigate.

future.name: Future
future.origin: The Future was a career criminal, operating for at least several decades. For an undetermined amount of time he was kept in an underground prison. He was able to escape from the prison after his body adapted to the sedatives they used on him. Knowing that his son, Shogo, was at the Jean Grey School for Higher Learning he proceed to attack the school, first shooting Primal then poisoning Sprite. Afterward, he sent a message to Jubilee stating that he was coming for his son and would kill everyone in the school. After infiltrating the school, he defeated Jubilee in hand-to-hand combat. He proceeded to also defeat Psylocke in hand-to-hand combat after shaking off her psychic attack, but was confused when the X-Men killed one of his subordinates, stating it was out of character for them, and kidnapped Jubilee. When the X-Men retaliated, he deployed an organic forest with defensive capabilities to attack the X-Men. He offered Storm demands to end the assault and Storm refused them. After the Bloodline was neutralized, Jubilee broke out of her cell, but found that The Future had been killed by the Bloodline.
powers: The extent of his powers are not completely known. He seemed to be an enhanced human of some kind. He had enough strength to overpower and knock out Jubilee while afflicted with vampirism.

future man.name: Future Man
future man.origin: thumb|left|123px|Original appearance Future Man came from the year One Million AD of Earth-46141. In his time, all the worlds oceans had evaporated and the human race was on the brink of extinction. Future Man volunteered to travel back in time to the 20th century and exterminate the human race in that time so that he and his people could travel back and live on a fresh new world. From his time ship, Future Man travelled to the year 1946 and recruited the criminal Madame Death and her gang to assist him in attacks on each world continent, promising them their own domains to rule and riches. This plot was overheard by Captain America and Bucky who attacked, but Future Man tossed a dark bomb allowing them to escape. Captain America and Bucky then gathered the All-Winners Squad to patrol each continent to prevent Future Man's attacks. Future Man first attacked Europe where he and Madame Death's gang took over a laboratory in the Swiss Alps where Future Man developed bombs carrying the Green Plague. He tested a single bomb, wiping out an entire Swiss town before mass producing more. However, before Future Man and his minions could detonate any more bombs, Captain America and Bucky intervened, causing a massive avalanche that destroyed the laboratory. However, Future Man was only present in astral form and easily escaped and Madame Death got away in the confusion. Future Man and his cohorts next travelled to South America where they constructed a massive ray that caused humans to move in slow motion causing accidents all over the country. This plot was stopped by the Whizzer who, despite being slowed down by the ray, was still able to run at super speed and smashed the device. Once more Future Man and Madame Death managed to evade capture. In China, Future Man and Madame Death came to the rescue of pirates that were being attacked by the Sub-Mariner and conscripted them into their cause. On the ocean floor, Future Man had the pirates prepare a torpedo that would create a massive Tsunami that would flood all of Asia. Namor caught up with them and attacked. Impressed by Namor's strength, Future Man offered Namor a position in his group but the Sub-Mariner refused. Knocked out, Namor was tied to the torpedo, but the hero managed to break free and disarm it before it could explode. Escaping to Egypt, Future Man and Madame Death used a device to resurrect an entire tomb of mummies located within a pyramid to invade the country. These creatures were destroyed by Miss America who found herself briefly trapped in the pyramid, but she escaped thanks to Future Man's gloating accidentally exposing the trigger to escape the pyramid. Despite this set back, Future Man and Madame Death (also now using an astral projection of herself) were able to escape. Going to North America, the Future Man set a fire in a Canadian forest in order to distract the Human Torch and Toro while he carried out his actual plan: Using an Atomic Match to set the entire continent on fire, starting with the American South. The Torch and Toro quelled the fire in Canada and learned of the other fire and rushed back south. There the Future Man was foiled again when the Torch and Toro were able to put out the atomic fire with its ashes. As Future Man escaped once again he threatened to blow up the entire world with a Neutronic Bomb. There are two accounts of Future Man's defeat. In the original account, Future Man's ship was located by the heroes who then crashed it in the desert. With the heroes invading his ship, Future Man then attempted to contact the invasion force in the future but his time radio was destroyed by the Torch and Toro. Deciding to return to the future, Future Man then activated his time machine as the All-Winners Squad fled. Future Man soon realized to his horror that Captain America damaged the time engine making it so that the machine hurtled back into the past, sending Future Man and Madame Death farther and farther back in time. In the second account, Future Man's ship was found just outside the Statue of Liberty. During the fight, Captain America tossed his shield at Future Man who turned intangible, and by complete fluke, the heroes shield struck the ships control panels damaging the radio and causing the ship to malfunction. The heroes fled as the ship was sent hurtling into the distant past. Future Man and Madame Death found themselves trapped one million years in the past. future max.name: Future Max
future max.origin: Max was a young, bright student living in New York with his mother. He suffered from some form of nerve damage, primarily in the arms and legs. He used his inventions to commit robberies in order to secure funds for his final project dubbed by himself as 'Future Max', which in theory would aid, if not fix his condition. While attending a science fair at Midtown High School, he was approached by out-of-work actor Alexis Sharp who posed as an agent for a technological institute. He tricked Max into making him an exoskeleton by promising to introduce Max to Reed Richards. Sharp's real plan was to use the exoskeleton to commit robberies. Sharp fought with Spider-Man, but Max helped Spider-Man defeat Sharp with some advice.
abilities: Max had no powers, but was a bright man and genius inventor, enough so to create a super suit with military-grade armaments.
weaknesses: Max suffered from some unnamed condition that required him to wear braces on his legs.

fuzmyer.name: Fuzmyer
fuzmyer.origin: Fuzmyer was the sole survivor of Vydos, a planet devoured by Galactus. He joined another group of survivors of Galactus in Newhaven, a hidden planet inhabited exclusively by the last members of their respective species. When the Silver Surfer and his companion Dawn Greenwood arrived by accident to Newhaven, they attracted the attention of Galactus, who followed the Surfer's trail of cosmic energy to Newhaven. Even after Dawn tried to sacrifice herself to become the Devourer's new herald to spare Newhaven from destruction, its inhabitants decided it was better to leave the planet for Galactus to devour, and they fled. Because he was the reason Galactus destroyed Newhaven, the Silver Surfer promised the former inhabitants to find them a new planet, and he became their herald. Surfer's deed came to an end once he discovered a planet with a adaptive atmosphere that allowed all of the survivors from different species to live on it. After months of inhabiting this "New Newhaven," the Silver Surfer discovered it was actually a living planet called Euphoria, that used its adaptive atmosphere to defend itself from the survivor's grief by inducing them happiness and controlling their actions to ensure their well-being. A group of the survivors decided to leave the planet as they didn't want to be Euphoria's puppets, but the vast majority remained on it, including Fuzmyer.

fyodor dostoyevsky android.name: Fyodor Dostoyevsky (Android)
fyodor dostoyevsky android.origin: The Mad Thinker's Fyodor Dostoyevsky android was based upon the Russian novelist, best known for his novels Crime and Punishment, The Brothers Karamazov, and The Idiot. The Thinker created this android as part of a group of androids based on great thinkers from history, housed in a laboratory under Ponder, New Hampshire. He hoped that they would be able to make new applications of their philosophies for the modern age, but they were all unable to think outside of their historical context. Considering the androids to be failures, the Mad Thinker began kidnapping living Nobel Prize winners, so he can make android copies of them for a more modern think tank. When Captain America and Team America rescued the Nobel Prize winners, Dostoyevsky's memory circuits were damaged, and he simply wandered off. Dostoyevsky was next seen in Rain, New Hampshire, where he wandered into town holding a bloody knife. He was arrested under suspicion of being the serial killer who had been operating in town for months. After staying in jail for days, Dostoyevsky was compelled to return to Ponder when the town's remaining androids sent out a call to the the Vision. Dostoyevsky broke out of jail and walked to Ponder, pursued by a mob of Rain citizens and Spider-Man who was in town covering the serial killer story. Everyone converged in Ponder, where the androids were asking Vision to teach them about humanity. A huge conflict ensued, only ending when Officer Bob Rubens was revealed to be the serial killer, and apprehended. The androids of Ponder welcomed Dostoyevsky back into their group, and decided to return to their isolation and not study with the Vision for the time being. The Mad Thinker eventually returned to the Ponder laboratory and evicted the androids. Many of the androids went on to found the town of Nüponder, Michigan. It is unknown if Dostoyevsky was among them.

fyodor tesla.name: Fyodor Tesla
fyodor tesla.origin: Fyodor Tesla is an actor who had been cast in the leading role of an upcoming, low-budget action movie titled Retaliator. The Punisher becomes aware of the production not because of the movie itself, but because the film's director, C.B. Bissel, has a dark reputation. Bissel's movie sets suffer from an impossibly high and suspicious number of real-world "accidental" deaths. Realizing Bissel is actually running a front to produce illegal snuff films on camera, Frank Castle goes undercover on the set as a Hollywood stuntman to infiltrate the operation. He becomes a victim of his own reckless lifestyle and the director's greed. Before the Punisher can intervene or confront him directly, Fyodor is murdered by C.B. Bissel. The director orchestrates his death to capture the real-life demise of his lead actor on film for maximum profit.

g dey.name: G-Dey
g dey.origin: G-Dey and Bumps, two street criminals, boasted about killing a cop and believed that with Daredevil and Spider-Man out of the picture, they could take over the streets. But when they entered a room, they found the Punisher waiting for them. The Punisher knew one of them had killed a cop and sat them down at a table with two guns, telling them both to take theirs. This way, he could identify the killer by knowing which gun had killed the cop. The killer turned out to be Bumps, and so the Punisher gave G-Dey the option to leave if he shot Bumps in the head. G-Dey did so, and, confident he could escape unharmed, he agreed to wear a sign the Punisher had given him around his neck. To his surprise, he realized the Punisher wouldn't let him leave alive, so he shot him dead and fell onto the street, where it was revealed that the sign had a skull with the word "BACK" written on it.

When Captain America discovered the military connection to the Power Broker and threatened to reveal it to the public, Lynch ordered G.I. Max to neutralize Rogers to keep the connection secret. Rogers was able to hold off G.I. Max. So, Lynch fired at Rogers with his handgun. However, the bullet bounced off Rogers' shield and struck G.I. Max in the neck, killing him.

gabbo.name: Gabbo
gabbo.origin: Gabbo was a famous ventriloquist who astonished audiences for years with his ability to throw his voice and make it seem that his dummy was alive. Their comedy routine won them accolades and invitations to prestigious events. The dummy, however, was actually Hugo a midget dressed in a wooden mask. Gabbo and Hugo were later employed by Luther Cragg on his riverboat which was used as a mobile base of operations for his criminal activities. Cragg employed Gabbo to entertain his unsuspecting audiences with his performances. Gabbo also played another role in Cragg's operation, for he would send Hugo to rob the guests' rooms while they slept, taking advantage of Hugo's size to slip in and out unnoticed. Cragg's operation was eventually opposed by his enemy, the Rawhide Kid. The Kid was on the verge of defeating Cragg and his men when Gabbo threw a pot of paste over his pistols, rendering them useless. The Kid was then defeated and placed in the brig with the real crew of the riverboat. The Kid and crew soon escaped and again meant to bring Cragg to justice. This time Gabbo used a small mirror to blind the Kid during a draw with one of Cragg's henchmen. Hugo, however, turned on his partner and gave the Kid the help he needed to defeat Cragg and his men. Gabbo was then arrested along with the rest of the gang and sent to jail for his crimes. Hugo was subsequently trained as a gunslinger by the Rawhide Kid and years later Gabbo sought him out to rescue his daughter from savage Indians who had kidnapped her. Though there was no love lost between the the former partners, Hugo agreed to try and rescue the girl.
abilities: It is unclear if Gabbo possessed any skill as a ventriloquist as he relied on using the little person, Hugo, to give the appearance of making a dummy talk.
