gennady gavrilov.name: Gennady Gavrilov
gennady gavrilov.species: Human who used Anton Vanko's lost prototype Crimson Dynamo Armor Mark II
gennady gavrilov.origin: Gennady Gravilov (Russian: Геннадий Дмитриевич Гаврилов) was a bright student, but had a habit of taking and hiding items. He was almost expelled from school for taking batteries. thumb|left|160px Gennady also spent most of his time on the Internet messaging a "cajun angel." While working at Moscow State University, transporting boxes of paperworks from warehouses, Gennady came across a helmet from a prototype Crimson Dynamo armor made by the late Anton Vanko. He accidentally triggered the armor's activation via the helmet's remote control and homing mode. The armor went on a rampage throughout Russia in its attempt to get itself to the helmet while Gennady initial believed the helmet to be a virtual reality gaming system. Gennady learned from Vanko's notes that the armor builds an massive electromagnetic charge. Without special gauntlets, it would overload. Gennady was pursued by the rogue spy Alexandre Deveraux as well as the russian military who were all after the armor. With the help of Wayne Jennings, an arms inspector, Gennady was able to stop the armor. Anthony Stark offered his technical assistance if needed. Gennady managed to escape from the military with the armor via a railway using the armors maglev system. Gennady then hid the armor in basement of his stepfather's warehouse, stating an intention to become a superhero and unaware that Tony Stark still maintained a remote kill switch for the armor should he ever decide to shut Gennady down.

After Widow managed to recover the stolen technology, she found Gennady held hostage by Sofia who forced Widow to hand it over to her, only for Sofia to shoot Gennady in the head, killing him, and then flee.

genrami.name: Genrami
genrami.origin: Genrami was an Indian mirror maker who was loyal to the Imperial Japanese during World War II. Late in the war, he discovered a rare mineral known as Trilite, which would cause blindness in those who looked at it. Using Trilite in his Myriad of Mirrors attraction, he admitted American soldiers with the purpose of them going blind in the battle field. When this proved to be a success, he then began creating mirror sculptures which he intended to sell to American soldiers camped outside of town to strike more blind. However, as he was preparing for this second sneak attack, Captain America and Bucky became wise to his operation and went to confront him. Genrami had his men overpower the heroes and had them locked in an air tight room surrounded with Trilite mirrors, mockingly leaving them some papers to read before going off to sell his hazardous wares to the soldiers. However, Captain America and Bucky soon freed themselves, and after obtaining a black light projector that could cure those blinded by Trilite, they rushed off to stop Genrami. Fleeing, Genrami attempted to blind Captain America with a stronger Trilite mirror. However, Cap tackled his foe, knocking out Genrami's protective contact lenses. Looking into his own mirror, Genrami was instantly blinded and fell off a cliff to his death. Captain America and Bucky then used the black light projector to cure all his victims.

geoffrey sydenham.name: Geoffrey Sydenham
geoffrey sydenham.origin: left|thumb|Geoffrey Sydenham in 1941 In 1941, Captain America, Logan, Ivan Petrovich, and Natasha Alianovna asked ambassador Geoffrey Sydenham for help, but he was actually a traitor who was allied with Baron Strucker. He took them as prisoners, believing the true destiny of the United States was to join with Germany in an Aryan hegemony against communism. He was eventually defeated and went to jail on charges of treason and sedition. While in prison he was approached by Dormammu who agreed to teach him the dark arts. Dormammu convinced Sydenham that it was more useful to recruit enemies to work for him in his greater struggle against communist Russia. As such, when he was released, Sydenham began recruiting former Nazi operatives into his new organization ICON. To this end, he recruited such Nazi superhumans as Baron Blood, Brain Drain, the Ubermadchen, and many others to put his plan into action. He managed to get the backing of American Senator Sanford, who agreed with Sydenham about the threat of Russia to the American way of life. The undersecretary also tried to assassinate Nick Fury's Avengers, but they all managed to survive. Sydenham also kidnapped T'Chaka, the ruler of the secret African nation of Wakanda, in order to ensure that country's compliance in the upcoming war. He later sent his ICON operatives to the technologically advanced nation in an attempt to pillage its futuristic technology to use in their war against the Russians. This plan was foiled, however, by the Avengers. Sydenham was finally defeated when the Avengers teleported to Washington, D.C. and soundly beat the last of his super-powered followers. Powell McTeague then ensnared a fleeing Sydenham in mystical chains and turned him over to the authorities. He was soon released by a government sub-committee headed by Senator Sanford who opted not to prosecute him in exchange for him revealing the location of T'Chaka. Sydenham was last seen in Greenwich Village again using his black magic for some unspecified purpose. His subsequent activities are as yet unrevealed.
powers: Sydenham appears to possess some magical talents that were taught to him by the Dread Dormammu. These powers include, but are not limited to, his ability to teleport items and individuals.

geoffrey vandergill.name: Geoffrey Vandergill
geoffrey vandergill.origin: Geoffrey Vandergill lived in the New York City during World War II and joined Captain America's Sentinels of Liberty youth group. He met Captain America's sidekick Bucky and become part of the Young Allies a group of wartime youths who would work to fight Nazi spies and other menaces to America during World War II. ===Pre-Face: Truth and Fiction=== It has been revealed that a lot of the Young Allies wartime adventures were made into a comic book as propaganda for the United States to earn support in the war effort, especially among young impressionable people. The comic book, while based on true events, were often times embellished and sensationalized. Further, to "protect" the identities of the Young Allies (however, in later years, Bucky would suspect it was to avoid having to pay out royalties for the use of their likenesses), they were all portrayed as caricatures of themselves, and young adolescents around the age of 12, while in real life they were in their late teens to early adulthood and eventually became old enough to enlist in the military and see action in the battle field. In these comics Geoffrey was portrayed as "Jeff", the brains of the group. Geoff appeared to have no problem with his depiction in these stories. The fictional accounts of the Young Allies are the most complete record of their activities during World War II, however how much of these tales are fiction and how much are truth have yet to be completely chronicled. For the purposes of clarity between what is known to be fully factual and what is regarded as sensationalized fiction, both will be addressed separately in this profile. ===Real Life History=== Shortly after the formation of the Young Allies, Geoff joined his comrades in smashing a Nazi spy ring in New York leading to a clash with the Red Skull. The youths would be assisted by the timely arrival of Captain America and the Human Torch. In 1943, Jeff and the Young Allies were sent to Hollywood California for a war bond drive. The rally was soon marred by an panic caused by Bucky and Toro's foe Lady Lotus, and they soon broke up the panic. Jeff and his friends were then ordered by the military to report to Democracy Pictures to participate in a film that was in support of the war. They were once more targeted by Lady Lotus who hypnotized actors to attack them, and then took Toro under her control. Capturing the team, Lady Lotus hypnotized the rest of the group and as part of her plan to take over the American west coast sent the group in a B-17 and P-40 to attack Muroc Army Airfield. However, Washington Jones snapped out of Lady Lotus' control and managed to help the others break free from her mind control. They got the air field's participation in a ruse that made it appear their attack was a success. Pretending to still be under the control of Lady Lotus, the Young Allies got close enough to attack her. During the battle, Toro managed to knock a crystal that Lotus was using to boost her powers and it was subsequently swallowed up by the Earth. Lady Lotus then fled, vowing to get revenge against the Young Allies someday. Coming of age, Geoff and his fellow Young Ally Henry Tinkelbaum became members of the Office of Strategic Services (the wartime precursor to the CIA). In 1944, Geoff reunited with his fellow Young Allies when they all had some downtime. Meeting in France, the Young Allies had their festivities cut short when Geoff spotted German operative Hauptman Kleinschmidt. With himself and Henry using their spy skills to pose as the operatives that Kleinschmidt and his minions were waiting to report to, they provided ample distraction for the rest of the Young Allies to ambush the spies, leading to Kleinschmidt's ultimate death. This was the last time the Young Allies would fight together, but they all stayed in touch over the years. ===Fictional History=== thumb|left|"Jeff" circa 1941 For a detailed account of the fictional history of Jeff Vandergill see the Fictional History of the Young Allies. ===After the War=== After the war, Geoffrey remained with the OSS and was active after it became the CIA. He continued to serve his country until he was reported as killed in action fighting in Indochina (modern day Vietnam). His body was buried in Arlington National Cemetery in Arlington, Virginia.

geoffrey wickshire.name: Geoffrey Wickshire
geoffrey wickshire.origin: Geoffrey and his step-brother Edmund, owned an estate out on the moor, but Edmund wished to destroy his blind brother, so he could have all the estate. He pretended to show good will to Geoffrey and offered to take him out for a walk onto the moor. He led him to a pit of quicksand and then shouted about running off some poachers and left his brother alone. When Geoffrey stumbled into the quicksand, Edmund was overjoyed and went back to the house. That evening, he felt guilty and cannot sleep. He thought to hears a noise upon the stairs. To his horror, the door opened, and a thing covered in wet sand slowly advanced upon him. He backed away, towards the open window. It turned out that Geoffrey was rescued by Leprechauns that lived under the bog, and they offered to repair his sight if he would have stayed with them for a week. He was overjoyed and wished to tell his brother that, once his sight was repaired, he would do what he had always wanted to do and go out to sea. This meant that Edmund will get the full estate. He was puzzled when his brother doesn't responded. Even though Edmund got what he wanted, he didn't get to enjoy it. Since he was so terrified by what he took to be his brother's corpse seeking revenge, he backed away too far, falling through an open window and into the courtyard below.
weaknesses: Formerly blindness

geomancer china.name: Geomancer (China)
geomancer china.origin: Dei Guan was an orphan in China after his parents were killed for being considered dissidents. Dei was sent to a re-education camp and later was forced into labour in a mine. It was during one of his shifts in the iron mine that the mysterious Geomancer appeared and told Dei Guan that their ancestors believed that "Dragons of Jade" lived beneath the earth and lent their powers to great warriors. He then imparted to Dei Guan the power of the Jade Dragon, allowing him to change into a massive dragon form.
powers: Magical skills - extent of which are unknown.

geometer.name: Geometer
geometer.origin: Geometer was a member of an unknown, long extinct alien race of scientists. He believed he had discovered a mathematical equation that fully described the workings of the universe, but another of his race made a physical observation his equation had not accounted for. Annoyed, Geometer left to find a universe that did fit and discovered the Lathe of Perfection that allowed him to change anything into perfect geometries. He spent billions of years traveling to different universes, where he discovered a man from his native reality. He tried to use the Lathe on him, but the man escaped through another rift before the process was complete. The Geometer then followed him back to his home reality, and come into conflict with Quasar. The Geometer tried to remake this universe, but Quasar was able to convince him that too many imperfections existed for this to work and instead should travel back in time to the beginning of the universe. Quasar expected that this would create a divergent timeline if the Geometer survived. His fate after this is unknown, but the Geometer or another of his race was present during the Maximum Security crisis.

george ailen.name: George Ailen
george ailen.origin: Prof. George Ailen was the United States' top geologist. His instruments detected lifeforms that lived deep below the Earth's surface and tried to warn everyone about these lifeforms, but no one believed him. Ailen was eventually proven correct when two Stone Men emerged from the ground in Times Square and started to rampage. Ailen was accused by an angry mob of being in league with the Stone Men. Ailen refuted the claim and also argued that the Stone Men were harmless as they hadn't hurt anyone during their rampage. Ailen was able to convince the U.S. Army to stop attacking the Stone Men and leave them be. The Stone Men eventually returned to their home deep belowground. When the Army expressed concern that more Stone Men would come to attack, Ailen assured them that they had nothing to worry about because the Stone Men were adapted to living deep belowground and thus couldn't sense anything on the Earth's surface and that the Stone Men that appeared were merely exploring.
abilities: Expertise in geology

george brinner.name: George Brinner
george brinner.origin: George Brinner found a wealthy deposit of bauxite in the mountains of the an unspecified southern state on the properties of the Rand and Coger families. Learning that the two clans have been feuding for years, Brinner attempted to exacerbate things further, while appearing to be a friendly neighbor. After Lee Coger and Jonce Rand were drafted into the U.S. Military and stationed at Camp Lehigh, Brinner sent Lee a letter warning him that Rand was going to play a trick on him. When the two southerners began to fight, that fight was intercepted by Private Steve Rogers and camp mascot James Buchanan Barnes (secretly Captain America and Bucky). When Bucky was forced to defend himself against Jonce Rand, Brinner secretly stabbed Rand in the back, framing Bucky for the murder. Posing as a military police officer, Brinner pulled a gun on the men gathered at the scene. However, Lee noticed that Brinner's pistol was not military issue and jumped him before fleeing the scene along with Steve Rogers. Brinner also fled while the military arrested Bucky. Knowing that Lee would go and warn the rest of the Coger family, Brinner followed him south and killed Lee before he could warn his family -- who was already prepared to attack the Rands thanks to radio coverage of the murder. When Captain America arrived to try and talk the Rands and Coger out of feuding, Brinner attempted to kill Colonel Rand, convincing the patriarch to have Captain America held at gun point while the rest of the Rands went to go meet the Cogers. Brinner's undoing came when he stopped in his plan to charm Drusilla Rand, who was charged with guarding Captain America, allowing Cap to escape. Convinced that the Rand and Coger families would slay each other, Brinner ventured to a nearby telephone box to call the authorities only to be caught red handed by Captain America. During their struggle, Brinner succeeded in gaining the upper hand by throwing Cap off a nearby cliff. Brinner then went to gather his gang to prepare to eliminate any survivors of the clash. Captain America and Bucky arrived and broke up the gang, but Brinner fled. Cap brought the captured gang and had them confess the whole plot to both families, finally bringing them to peace. Seeing this, Brinner attempted to slay the patriarchs of both families, only to be stopped by Captain America and Bucky. With his plot ruined, Brinner was turned over to the authorities.
abilities: George Brinner was an expert knife thrower.
weapons: Brinner primarily used throwing knives and was armed with a pistol.

However, Lee noticed that Brinner's pistol was not military issue and jumped him before fleeing the scene along with Steve Rogers. Brinner also fled while the military arrested Bucky. Knowing that Lee would go and warn the rest of the Coger family, Brinner followed him south and killed Lee before he could warn his family -- who was already prepared to attack the Rands thanks to radio coverage of the murder. When Captain America arrived to try and talk the Rands and Coger out of feuding, Brinner attempted to kill Colonel Rand, convincing the patriarch to have Captain America held at gun point while the rest of the Rands went to go meet the Cogers. Brinner's undoing came when he stopped in his plan to charm Drusilla Rand, who was charged with guarding Captain America, allowing Cap to escape. Convinced that the Rand and Coger families would slay each other, Brinner ventured to a nearby telephone box to call the authorities only to be caught red handed by Captain America. During their struggle, Brinner succeeded in gaining the upper hand by throwing Cap off a nearby cliff. Brinner then went to gather his gang to prepare to eliminate any survivors of the clash. Captain America and Bucky arrived and broke up the gang, but Brinner fled. Cap brought the captured gang and had them confess the whole plot to both families, finally bringing them to peace. Seeing this, Brinner attempted to slay the patriarchs of both families, only to be stopped by Captain America and Bucky. With his plot ruined, Brinner was turned over to the authorities.

george hill criminal.name: George Hill (Criminal)
george hill criminal.origin: George Hill was a low level thug who robbed a bank one day. While he and the other two thugs tried to make their escape, they almost hit Aunt May with their getaway car. Enraged, Peter Parker left momentarily to become Spider-Man and chase down the thugs. He caught two of the three thugs, while the third thug, Georgie, escaped into the sewers. Not wanting to spend his afternoon in the dark, dank, odiferous sewer, Spider-Man let George go. While making his way through the New York Sewer System, George stumbled across a secret hideout once belonging to the original Green Goblin, Norman Osborn. Realizing the value of what he found, George contacted Roderick Kingsley, a crooked fashion industry mogul, who had criminal ties to the underworld. Kingsley was very interested in what George had found and had him load all the hideout's contents into a van. After finally emptying the van, Kingsley told George to dispose of the van so it couldn't be traced to them. While driving away, Kingsley detonated an explosive in the van on George, ensuring that all ties to their earlier theft of the Green Goblin hideout would indeed be severed.

george howe.name: George Howe
george howe.origin: As a young man, George Howe served in the United States Army during the Vietnam War. In the summer of 1969, his helicopter crashed near the border near Laos; the Viet-Cong soon arrived, capturing the survivors and taking them back to their base. One by one Howe's comrades were killed, their hands and feet chopped off and tossed into his bamboo cage. When it seemed that his time had come, a Marine Force Recon unit led by Captain Frank Castle attacked the village and rescued Howe. Admiring the special operations personnel for their proficiency, Howe joined the Green Berets for the remainder of the war and was among the first to be recruited into Delta Force. Almost forty years later, Howe was a Colonel in the Army's elite Delta Force. Around this time, he was tasked by a cabal of military generals to arrest Castle, who possessed incriminating evidence on the generals' involvement in Operation Barbarossa. Howe was aware of the smallest details of Barbarossa as his former son-in-law Martin Vanheim was part of the mission along with Castle that resulted in the former's death. Howe was not driven by a desire to avenge Vanheim, however; instead, he was committed to bringing Castle to justice as he felt he was a disgrace to the U.S. military for using his skills he learned in Special Forces to murder thousands in his vigilantism as the Punisher. Upon capturing Castle, Howe learned the truth of Operation Barbarossa from William Rawlins' taped confession. He then allowed Castle to kill the generals by giving him a loaded handgun, and destroys the incriminating evidence out of the belief that if exposed, the U.S. military would lose all sense of credibility.
abilities: George is an accomplished Special Forces soldier. He spent years with the Green Berets and then with Delta Force.
weaknesses: Despite being a highly-trained soldier, Howe still has all the weaknesses that a normal human being does.

george huston.name: George Huston
george huston.origin: George was a playboy and a swindler who duped the girls with his charm and appropriated their money. After receiving the letter from Rona, a desperate girl for not having any more news about the man she loves, Venus goes in search of George and with his powers made George fall in love with her and convinced him to return the stolen goods to the girls he had cheated and definitively leaving the girls telling them all that he had fallen in love with Venus and they would get married. But when George and Venus arrived at Rona's house, they found her sick with little desire to live until she heard George's voice. Rona slips out of her coma until George confesses that he only loves Venus, causing Rona to slip back into her current state. With Rona's situation becoming fatal, Venus quickly teleports back to Olympus where she petitions Jupiter for his help. Jupiter agrees to assist allowing Venus to endow to part of her love power to Rona. Venus invisibly returns to Earth and gives a portion of her power to Rona, who snaps out of her coma. George instantly falls in love with her, curing of her condition.

During Cletus Kasady's takeover of the town, George and Martha were forced to spend time with Kasady on their porch. george mulford.name: George Mulford
george mulford.origin: George Mulford was a ruthless career criminal who was active in the United States during the 1920s. He was arrested after a series of large hold-ups that he committed and was jailed. Breaking out of jail, Mulford stole an experimental spaceship to escape the authorities and soon found himself rocketed off to the planet Venus where he met a race of Venusians who welcomed him with open arms. While on Venus, he taught the people how to speak English and soon became enamored with the woman named Vanza. Learning how to use Venusian technology, Mulford freed a number of criminals from the "Water City" prison, promising them countless riches on Earth once he brought them to America. Forcing Vanza to accompany him and his minions, Mulford used his spaceship to return to Earth. Arriving on the island of Barbuda during the early months of 1945, Mulford and his men used the advanced technology from Venus to slaughter the people of Barbuda and began ransacking the island's wealth. Their murderous attacks attracted the attention of the Sub-Mariner who happened to be vacationing in the area at the time. Namor's attempts to stop the Venusians always came too late, as he failed to stop them from both robbing Barbuda's national bank and kidnapping Billy Steele, the British ambassador's son. Eventually, Namor rescued Vanza, who explained to him how they came to his world and led him to Mulford's secret hideout. There, Mulford's minions captured the pair and Mulford ordered their deaths. Before his men could comply, the Sub-Mariner fought them off and then impaled Mulford on a stalagmite and then set his base to explode, killing all his men and destroying the advanced Venusian technology.

george mullaney.name: George Mullaney
george mullaney.origin: George Mullaney was one of the individuals given paranormal abilities by the White Event, though his were more extreme than most: his entire body began to continually mutate, reconfiguring itself into a completely new form every 24 hours and remaining stable only for the middle 12 hours each time (these mutated forms were rarely human, though usually basically humanoid).He became a patient at the Clinic for Paranormal Research, but had few friends there as most of the other patients were repulsed by his bizarre appearance(s). The one real exception was Jeff Walters who was the only person who was ever actually nice to George. When Walters fled the Clinic, grief stricken at the loss of his family in the destruction of Pittsburgh, George told Walters' friends where he believed he had gone, and stowed away in David Landers' Winnebago when they went after him. Never really accepted by the rest of the group, he was nonetheless later rescued from a group of scavengers by Charlotte Beck, Lenore Fenzl, and Jenny Swensen and remained with them for several days until they were all captured by the Army. Months later, Mullaney recognized Charlotte Beck, whom he'd had a crush on at the Clinic, in New York and, having finally mutated into a handsome human form, approached her, calling himself 'John Mason'. The pair went on a date, but Mullaney eventually left Beck after a pleasant day together, after revealing his true identity to her and telling her that he knew she would be disgusted by him when he began to change again and that his real form wasn't as handsome as John Mason. Later, Mullaney (now in a spider-like form) allowed himself to be cured of his parability by William Wexler, the paranormal called The Cure. Beck, who was present at the time, watched him leave and reflected that his normal form wasn't too bad after all, though he was no John Mason.
powers: in arachnid form, he'd be able to stick to walls, and so on.
weaknesses: Mullaney was unable to control his mutations.

george patton.name: George Patton
george patton.origin: General George S. Patton retraced his entire military career similarly to that astride his real world counterpart. After the Allied landings in Sicily, he complained to his officers about how Montgomery was handling the situation and how impatient he was to get to Messina and then continue on to Italy to drive out the Nazis and march straight for Germany. At some point, General Patton was summoned by the Martian Kara to the ruins of 30th century New York, where Kara intended to assemble an army of generals and soldiers from history to conquer the Solar System, including Achilles, Hector, Hannibal, Caesar, Alexander the Great, Attila the Hun, Sversky, Allelo, Napoléon, Cromwell, and Lafayette. Instead, the assembled army turned against Kara and killed him, then warned Earth Government of the Martian threat, and offered to help as strategists. Humanity consequently conducted preemptive, genocidal strikes on the cities of Mars, though the time-displaced soldiers were of little use due to their lack of knowledge and understanding of the future surrounding them, and instead mostly watched and tried to learn. After Mars was wiped out, they were awarded a special medal voted by congress. Remaining there for another month to witness the future, they eventually said their goodbyes and faded away, returning to their respective eras, to the moment they had been taken, unbeknownst to all but them. Having realized the vastness of the universe, they all grasped the impossibility of conquering it, and all lost their appetite for war and conquest, explaining why none would conquer the Earth.

george peshaur.name: George Peshaur
george peshaur.origin: Wyatt is challenged by a cowboy named George Peshaur who thinks Wyatt is a coward for not fighting it out one on one. Wyatt accepts the challenge and the two men are locked in the back room of the cigar shop to fight it out with nothing but their bare hands.; It sounds like a rough fight and the locals believe that Peshaur won when he comes out the door first until he keels over right away. Earp comes out standing telling the people that George got out first because he was trying to flee. ; Later Wyatt is challenged by George who openly calls the marshal a coward. However despite the fact that George draws first, Wyatt is able to whirl around and shoot the gun out of his hand. Wyatt then tells George and his friends to clear out of town or be thrown in jail. George complies but vows to get revenge on Earp.; Over the next few days, Wyatt notices other rough and tumble cowboys appearing in town: John Wesley Hardin and George's cousin Mannen Clements, asking about George and Wyatt smells trouble brewing. Wyatt follows them out of town to a nearby cabin and listens in on their conversation. He overhears them plotting to get rid of him, but Mannen refuses to get involved telling George that Wyatt is too tough to beat. Mannen's turning down the job does not dissuade George from continuing to plot his revenge and once Wyatt has heard enough he heads back to Wichita.; Meanwhile in town, Ida May -- owner of one of the town honky tonk and George's girlfriend -- refuses to pay a bill collector for the piano that she purchased for the bar. When the man tells her that if she does not return it or pay the full balance he will get the marshal involved. Ida scoffs at this and has one of the patrons toss the collection agent out. When Wyatt returns to town he is told what happened and resolves to deal with it right away. Gathering up some of his friends from his days as a buffalo hunter, Wyatt and his pals arrive at the bar. There they come to claim the the piano.; As it turns out George Peshaur is there and when he tries to draw on Wyatt the lawman shoots the holster off his belt before he can draw his guns. Before the other patrons can pull out their guns, the buffalo hunters reveal that they have been hiding their rifles in the cushioning blankets and have gotten the drop on them. Stuck in a no win situation, Ida collects money from all her patrons to cover the rest of the cost of the piano and Wyatt and his friends leave, but as they do George still vows to get revenge against Wyatt Earp. ; In search of revenge George convinced Mannen Clements to face Wyatt but at the time of the confrontation when he was face to face with Wyatt, Mannen retired, at which point George convinced Mannen's young cousin, a boy very good with guns, to face Wyatt but during the duel the young man was easily beaten by Wyatt even though he did not kill him and when the boy asked George to intervene he did not and Wyatt accused George of not having the guts and leaving the city permanently.

george prufrock.name: George Prufrock
george prufrock.origin: ===Early Life=== left|thumb|George Prufrock George Prufrock is the son of a wealthy fanatical right-wing Libertarian named Jethro Prufrock. George (alongside his sister Martha Prufrock) were trained physically and mentally by their father in an attempt to prepare them for the world. After graduating from university and despite wanting to be an actor, George became a scientist after being convinced to do so by his father who also got him a job at A.I.M.. While working at A.I.M., George was forced into stealing an experimental virus, the Progamma Virus, from a biotechnology lab, but in the middle of the robbery, was attacked by a guard, who he killed, though not before being exposed to some of the Virus during the fight with him. ===The Punisher=== Rapidly mutating due to exposure to the Virus, George, having become the Lifeform, encountered the Punisher at an A.I.M. base and battled him, eventually causing the vigilante to flee when his weapons proved ineffective against George. Following the Punisher to his father's mansion, a rambling George burst onto the scene while the Punisher was in the midst of a firefight with his sister and father. Killing his father, George was presumed dead when the Punisher, after being allowed access to the Prufrock weapons vault by Martha, blasted him in the face with a rocket launcher and knocked him into the ocean. ===Predator=== Resurfacing sometime later, the Lifeform, now possessing two personalities, one peaceful and the other evil, began to feed off people while living in the alleys of Hell's Kitchen, Manhattan. During an encounter with two gang members, the Lifeform was forced to flee from them and the recently arrived Daredevil when one of the gang members shot off its arm with an automatic rifle. While fleeing, the Lifeform was drawn into a battle with supervillainess Typhoid Mary who managed to successfully drive off the Lifeform by appealing to its peaceful side. Once more driven to wandering, the Lifeform attempted to feast on a pair of teenagers only to be stopped by Daredevil. Attempting to appeal to the Lifeform and convince it to seek aid, Daredevil could only watch as the Lifeform was attacked by police with tranquilizers (hastening its heart rate to the point Daredevil believed its heart would explode) and conventional firearms. Lifeform appeared to die when it collapsed to the ground and dissolved, leaving only a bubbling puddle. ===The Quality of Mercy=== thumb|left Regenerating, the Lifeform was approached by Mercy, an extraterrestrial who assisted beings wanting to die in committing suicide. Confused by the Lifeform's dual personality (one which wanted to die and the other which wanted to continue living), Mercy proceeded to teleport it to a ghost town in the Midwest where the Hulk was. Forcing the two minds of the Lifeform into a debate with the Hulk and his alter-ego, Dr. Bruce Banner, Mercy's machinations were ultimately fruitless, as in the end the Hulk and Lifeform only ended up fighting each other. After being knocked into a fire by the Hulk and temporarily killed by it, the Lifeform re-grew and was transported back to New York by Mercy. Despite it begging her to end its life, Mercy refused to do so and instead changed the Lifeform back into George Prufrock, but neglected to repair his damaged psyche. Mercy's transformation of the Lifeform back into George Prufrock proved only temporary, as, over time, George began to re-mutate. Tracking down a scientist named Lamar Kwiat who worked on the Progamma Virus, George discovered him in a hospital, slowly dying due to having been bitten by a monkey infected by with the Progamma Virus that had escaped when George first stole the Virus. Telling Lamar his origin and of his encounter with the Hulk and Mercy while he steadily mutated and devoured anyone who disturbed them, George (having become the Lifeform again) killed Lamar seeing itself as performing an act of mercy by killing the slowly dying scientist. ===Termination=== Devouring everyone in the hospital, the Lifeform drew S.H.I.E.L.D.'s attention, who contacted Mister Fantastic to deal with the creature. With help from the Silver Surfer, Mister Fantastic tracked the Lifeform, which had grown into a gigantic monstrosity composed of malformed tentacles, mouths, arms and bulging muscle, to the East River, where it had been in the midst of eating marine life. Incapacitating Mister Fantastic, the Lifeform was attacked by the Silver Surfer, who flew it to a dead planet in space that Galactus had previously consumed with the intent of destroying it. Before the Silver Surfer could kill the Lifeform, its good personality emerged and begged the Silver Surfer to end its life. Unable to bring himself to kill the Lifeform because doing so would mean killing its innocent side, Silver Surfer regrettably left the being on the planet, its good side begging for death and its evil side complaining of its hunger.
powers: Regenerative : Can survive on land, water, or in the vacuum of space. Matter Absorption: As Lifeform he could absorb organic matter.
abilities: George Prufrock has some experiences in combat including the use of firearms and knives.

george sporvan.name: George Sporvan
george sporvan.origin: George Sporvan was a scientist that was more concerned about his personal gain than using his skills to better mankind. george stanislaus.name: George Stanislaus
george stanislaus.origin: An industrialist who discovered an alternate dimension and intended to tap into its ungoverned natural resources for financial gain. He hired Skull the Slayer as a guide and Lee Forrester as a ship captain for his return to the dimension. When their ship crashed on the shore of the alien dimension and most of their crew was lost, the three sent a buoy through the portal hoping to get help. Stanislaus, impatient, went into the surrounding jungle. While his allies believed him dead, he actually discovered the Scorpius, an alien race who had discovered the planet and settled there. When the X-Men and Future Foundation arrived, looking for Lee, the groups split into several smaller groups, one of which, made up of Cyclops, Emma Frost, and Invisible Woman eventually discovered the Scorpius' city and Stanislaus therein. Leading the trio to the Scorpius Emperor, he stood by as the three were captured.

george stonewell.name: George Stonewell
george stonewell.origin: George Stonewell was a soldier who was assigned to Nick Fury's Howling Commandos after Dino Manelli was injured during a parachute jump. As Fury quickly discovered, Stonewell was a racist and an antisemite, who did not get along with the squad members who in his eyes were inferior, like Manelli, Izzy Cohen and Gabe Jones. He participated in a mission with the Howlers to disrupt Erwin Rommel's African campaign and was injured during the mission. To his horror, his life was saved thanks to a blood transfusion from Gabe Jones. He left the squad after this one mission. Despite their differences and not being able to shake their hands when he left the squad, he left a note to Izzy and Gabe, with his new address.

george talbot.name: George Talbot
george talbot.origin: George was the son of the Brigadier General Glenn Talbot and his wife Carla. George Talbot was with his parents while they were walking in Washington, D.C. He told his parents that he wanted to join the marine. After his father was told about the criminal Carl Creel, George and his mother ran away. He was later kidnapped by Hydra in order to blackmail his father, but was found by Phil Coulson and his team, who rescued him and took him to Zephyr One for recovery. George tried to help his father recover after he was shot and transferred to a military hospital. Glenn was sometimes subject to outbursts of fright that frightened George, although his mother Carla assured him that his father would be fine. Then, General Hale took his father out of the hospital, pretending to take him to another hospital where he would be treated better when in fact he was being captured by Hydra. After his father returned, he was different, he was aggressive and even tried to kill Carla, scaring George. But they were saved by the S.H.I.E.L.D..

george thurman.origin: CIA field officer George Thurman, had been killed by KGB torturer Dmitri Panshin. He was survived by his brother Nate, a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent. Nate was later manipulated by corrupt S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Tom Gittes to get involved in a conspiracy to kidnap and kill Panshin for his war crimes after the end of the Cold War, when Panshin was going to receive protection from the U.S. government; Gittes appealed to George's memory many times, until Nate decided that Gittes' methods were as immoral as Panshin's.

george timmins.name: George Timmins
george timmins.origin: Gloria was a handsome woman with whom George Timmins fell in love, but was refused by her when she realized that he was not the man she was looking for, in fact she revealed that she was a mutant with powers of intangibility and telekinesis and was looking for a man with powers similar to hers to be able to conceive a new super-race with which to replace humans. Arrested while attempting to strangle her, Timmins turned to the famous lawyer Perry Hammond to whom he told what had happened and then received a mocking taunt when the lawyer declared that he was the mutant that Gloria was looking for.

george vandergill.name: George Vandergill
george vandergill.origin: After Roderick Kingsley had raided several Osborn Industries buildings and found incriminating evidence on several multi-millionaires, he decided to blackmail them. The multi-millionaires, including Vandergill, were gathered together in the Century Club when the Hobgoblin announced his wishes. After Spider-Man had arrived to scare away the Hobgoblin, Vandergill decided to take an extended vacation to Bimini. He returned to Manhattan later during the Great Game, and was killed by the Hobgoblin.
